title: Tradeweb Ai-Price: Evolving Credit Pricing for Today’s Market
summary: The electronification of the U.S. credit market over the last ten years has led to huge changes in how clients and dealers trade bonds. From the growth of portfolio trading to parameter-based automated execution to interdealer sweeps, electronification has changed the market microstructure significantly, allowing for greater efficiency and cost savings.

many non-linear relationships between bonds in the same issuer,


sector
